source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Typeset school paper with no usable text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. Printed header: Final Examination - 2017-2018, ENGLISH LANGUAGE, Std. : VI, Time : 2 hrs. + 15 min., F. M. : 80; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session. Q1 (any one of four compositions) and Q2 (any one of two letters) are stored as alternatives sharing a choiceGroup. The Q3 reading passage (about 290 words) is not reproduced, so the questions that depend on it are flagged LOW. Where only a group total is printed it is divided evenly when that gives whole marks; groups with ½-mark items are kept as one entry. The icseboard.org watermark is ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.sectionTitle: II. Fill in the blanks with appropriate prepositions :
questions.text:
Fill in the blanks with appropriate prepositions :
1. We rejoiced ____ his success.
2. I listened ____ what she said.
3. He is negligent ____ his work.
4. He is guilty ____ theft.
5. I was annoyed ____ her conduct.
6. He invited his friends ____ dinner.
7. Fill the bottle ____ hot water.
8. Be careful ____your health.
9. Harish warned me ____ the danger.
10. My pen is superior ____ yours.
